name: scalarTrig
description: The move's sine and cosine come from the client's scalar routines; before, from its paired one

name: landingBounceCorrection
description: A landing bounces off the block the move's collision boxes pick (slime 1, a bed 0.75), only after a fall of at least 0.08, and the landing tick's gravity is corrected; before, only slime under the feet bounced, at any speed

name: scaffoldingClimbFlag
description: A held jump in scaffolding stops climbing when the climbable-block flag the last move left is off; before, on the tick the move is about to cross into a cell without scaffolding

name: levitationFullRewind
description: A Levitation added or removed takes effect from the tick after its stamp however late it arrives; before, from no earlier than 4 ticks before the current one
